description: Join us in Loves Park for a FREE community panel on the SAFE-T Act and its impact on Illinois communities, public safety, and law enforcement. Bob Fioretti’s SAFE-T Act Task Force, chaired by retired Riverside Police Chief Tom Weitzel, will bring the conversation directly to the public.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Bob for Illinois
title: SAFE T Act Task Force Community Forum with Bob Fioretti | Bob For Illinois
